description: This file contains implementation of Memory Protection Unit (MPU) configuration and management functions for ARM Cortex-M processors within the Zephyr RTOS, including region setup, enabling/disabling MPU, and handling architecture-specific details.

methods.name: region_allocate_and_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes an MPU region at a specified index with given configuration.

methods.name: mpu_configure_regions_from_dt
methods.description: Configures MPU regions based on device tree memory attributes.

methods.name: mpu_configure_region
methods.description: Configures a single MPU region with specified partition parameters.

methods.name: mpu_configure_regions
methods.description: Configures multiple MPU regions over a background area, with optional sanity checks.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_enable
methods.description: Enables the MPU, architecture-specific implementation included.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_disable
methods.description: Disables the MPU, architecture-specific implementation included.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_mem_partition_config_update
methods.description: Updates configuration of an active memory partition.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_get_max_available_dyn_regions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of free MPU regions for dynamic configuration.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a buffer is accessible to user space.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_configure_static_mpu_regions
methods.description: Configures static MPU regions based on provided partitions.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_mark_areas_for_dynamic_regions
methods.description: Marks memory areas for dynamic MPU region configuration.

methods.name: z_arm_mpu_init
methods.description: Initializes the MPU with default and device tree regions.
